2607.13399.title: Demystifying On-Policy Distillation: Roles, Pathologies, and Regulations
2607.13399.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a key paradigm in LLM post-training, yet its training dynamics remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study examining the role, pathologies, and regulations of OPD. We first clarify the role of OPD as an exploration catalyst: it steers the student toward correct reasoning paths via dense token-level guidance, without expanding capability ceiling. We confirm this by showing that prompt diversity matters more than per-problem sampling numbers, and critically, that the effectiveness of OPD hinges entirely on the quality of its guiding signal. This dependency exposes two pathologies that derail exploration. The Student-Teacher Mismatch occurs when a large teacher-student distributional gap causes the guiding signal to misalign with task correctness, steering exploration in counterproductive directions. Length Exploitation arises when the aggregated token-level objective creates length-dependent shortcuts, allowing the student to game the reward landscape through response truncation or redundant padding, exploring degenerate length modes rather than reasoning strategies. To tame these pathologies, we investigate lightweight signal regulations: advantage clipping and log-scale compression, ensuring exploration is guided by faithful signals. Experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate that these regulations alleviate length exploitation and enable effective distillation, stably surpassing OPD variants and RLVR baselines, thereby confirming that well-regulated signal quality, rather than mere teacher scale, governs successful exploration in OPD.
2607.13399.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）已成為大型語言模型後訓練中的一個關鍵範式，但其訓練動態仍然不甚了解。<lb/>我們提出了一項系統性的研究，檢視OPD的角色、病理和規範。<lb/>我們首先澄清OPD作為探索催化劑的角色：它通過密集的標記級指導，引導學生朝向正確的推理路徑，而不擴展能力的上限。<lb/>我們通過顯示提示多樣性比每個問題的採樣數量更為重要來確認這一點，並且關鍵的是，OPD的有效性完全依賴於其指導信號的質量。<lb/>這一依賴性暴露了兩種病理，這些病理會破壞探索。<lb/>學生-教師不匹配發生在當一個大的教師-學生分佈差距導致指導信號與任務正確性不對齊時，從而將探索引導到反效果的方向。<lb/>長度利用則是當聚合的標記級目標創造了長度依賴的捷徑，使學生能夠通過響應截斷或冗餘填充來操控獎勵景觀，探索退化的長度模式而不是推理策略。<lb/>為了控制這些病理，我們研究了輕量級的信號規範：優勢裁剪和對數尺度壓縮，確保探索受到真實信號的引導。<lb/>在七個基準上的實驗表明，這些規範減輕了長度利用，並使有效的蒸餾成為可能，穩定地超越OPD變體和RLVR基準，從而確認良好規範的信號質量，而非單純的教師規模，主導了OPD中的成功探索。
